scope: Plaza standard sample only; this verdict does not represent the full host
decision: Attempt 9's only blocking masthead mismatch is closed. The system capsule, chevron and inner C motif all render at 0x0/display:none; the title has no focus target, role, cursor, hover delta or pointer behavior. The remaining hidden legacy nodes are non-blocking cleanup debt because they create neither visual nor accessibility affordance.

advisories.recommendation: Remove the dead legacy nodes when this experiment is promoted into a maintained host theme; no visual rework is required for the current sample.
